judgment: The swarm brought home materially different treasure: committed-content authority, replacement-object suppression, hostile fixtures, durable skill doctrine, and an accessibility-first source organism.

The first HEAD-tree implementation had a real Git replacement-ref authority hole. The correction is substantive and shared with existing authority-facing Git subprocesses; this earns the Originality Tax rather than a cosmetic retry.
The source specimen is justified because the new mismatch state is user-inspectable authority topology, not decoration.
Do not call this repository-skill content protection complete: the sole provenance owner still does not compare the exact observed SKILL.md content identity to its HEAD blob identity.
Do not promote regression fixtures to TESTED: exact-source-head workflows failed before exposing steps and logs were unavailable.
Phone/P0 and duplicate-architecture firewalls remained intact.
nextExactCut: Extend the existing single-artifact skill content observation with the Git blob identity derived from those same bytes, then compose the existing bounded HEAD blob observation + content-binding policy in the sole provenance owner.
